Why late

- The only recorded cause is that it is "not released" (WO-2026-00123). This is a contributing cause, not a full blocker—no blocking cause with no known ready date is present.

What it blocks

- Potentially affected sales orders (via downstream work orders) include:
    - SO-2026-00027, SO-2026-00192, SO-2026-00187, SO-2026-00056 (Tata Ficosa Automotive Systems)
    - SO-2026-00053, SO-2026-00198, SO-2026-00164, SO-2026-00039 (Kirloskar Pumps Ltd)
  These are potential exposures, not confirmed blocks.

Rescheduling
- I attempted to reschedule WO-2026-00123 and downstream work orders where permitted.
- WO-2026-00123 changed underneath during this process (someone else edited it), so no changes could be applied. All further rescheduling was refused for this reason.
- This issue has been escalated to Meera Kulkarni (ESC-2026-00010) for manual intervention and re-planning.

Not visible to me
- All relevant records were visible; no access issues.

Summary: WO-2026-00123 is late due to not being released. Downstream work orders and several sales orders may be affected, but the customer impact is partly unknown. Rescheduling could not be completed because the order changed during this process. The issue has been escalated for human resolution.
